excerpts:
An ordinary photo of an egg just won one of the internet's most coveted titles, and it's a largely a mystery how it all happened. A stock-like image of a brown egg, the only post from Instagram account @world_record_egg has more than 26 million likes. That beats Kylie Jenner's most-liked Instagram post from last year of 18 million likes announcing the birth of her daughter Stormi . Jenner's post showed her daughter's hand clinging to her mom's thumb and announced the newborn's name: Stormi Webster. excerpts:
A picture of an egg has become the most-liked post in Instagram history.
The record had previously been held by reality TV star Kylie Jenner. A photograph of an egg has overtaken Kylie Jenner as the holder of the most-liked post ever on Instagram. The picture – from account @world_record_egg – currently has almost 25 million likes, beating Jenner's record 18 million likes on a post announcing the birth of her daughter Stormi last year. "Let's set a world record together and get the most like post on Instagram," the post read. "Beating current world record held by Kylie Jenner (18 million). We got this!"
